support: Each time we passed beneath the scree, I caught myself counting Tomas's stakes and hoping that every one still stood where it had stood the day before.
At Tarsel the others stepped into the sun, but I stayed by the window, staring down the valley at that grey fan of stone.
WV13-P01.6.note: The narrator counts the stakes anxiously and stays staring at the scree that threatens the line, so the attitude is worry about its future, not nostalgia, criticism or admiration.
